name: qa_comp
title: OS-INSFX-FX1, the Comp effect module (modules/effects/comp, kind 2) as a track insert from the console: loaded from the card, bound with `diag ins`, heard, its tail ends, and its cost read with `diag bench insert` (bench image). Console only: the insert is NOT saved (S3), and the console has no insert parameter verb, so the TRANSIENT mode, Punch and Sustain and the Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release sweeps are a hand check once the Mixer's INSERTS page and the parameter page exist (S4, S5). Needs modules/effects/comp.tmod on the card (the build's modules/comp.tmod, copied by the tester). Reset the unit first so that comp is the only effect module loaded (`diag bench insert` times the first loaded effect). Writes nothing to the card. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX-FX1, rows QA-GLB-193 to 196 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; QA-GLB-194 and 195 are host tests). Put modules/effects/comp.tmod on the card, reset the unit so that no other effect module is loaded, and open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a sounding track 1 that has loud peaks). The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3). The default setting is COMP mode, Threshold -18 dB, Ratio 4, Attack 10 ms, Release 120 ms, Makeup 0 dB, Mix 100 %: track 1 must sound compressed on its loud passages and untouched under about -21 dBFS, and NEVER LOUDER than the bypassed track (`ins bypass 1 1 on` and `off` to compare)

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-193: the packed module passes the loader on the unit
QA-GLB-193: loaded, version 1.0.0; `mod` also says where its hot part runs (the SRAM_L slab or SDRAM): read it against the hot size of the build
QA-GLB-193: bound to track 1, slot 1, with its default parameters

QA-GLB-193: the insert runs (phase on) and its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line (the figure the spec estimates at 0.6 % [est] (about 1.6k cycles a block settled, COMP mode at the defaults))
QA-GLB-193: the load with the insert on; underruns 0; read it against the same project with no insert
QA-GLB-193: nothing was forced to dry

steps.say: QA-GLB-193, by ear: track 1 is compressed (Threshold -18 dB, Ratio 4: the loud hits come down by up to about 9 dB, the quiet parts under about -21 dBFS are untouched, no pumping artefact worse than a plain compressor's at Release 120 ms, no clicks) and its LEVEL IS NOT HIGHER than bypassed (the check DRIVE failed at its defaults: compare with `ins bypass 1 1 on`, and look for a hotter or clipped stem; Comp can only be quieter at Makeup 0); the other tracks are unchanged. Then `ins bypass 1 1 on`: the clean sound returns with no click

steps.note: QA-GLB-193: bypass is the host's one-block ramp to dry
QA-GLB-193: off resets the module (shutdown, init) and the effect starts from silence (followers at 0): no thump, the first loud hit passes for one attack time before it is compressed

QA-GLB-193: two and a half seconds after the stop there is no `tail` word: the followers have fallen under -80 dBFS (about 1.1 s from full scale at the default Release 120 ms) and the effect returns 0
QA-GLB-193: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the comp bound and idle

expect: BENCH insert \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(.*, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-196: bench image (`-DO3OS_BENCH=ON`), transport stopped, comp the only loaded effect: `insert_effect` is the settled render() of 64 frames at the defaults (COMP mode), `insert_effect_mod` the same with set_param on Threshold, the first MOD target, every block (a sweep), `insert` the whole insert with the adapter. Quote min, avg and max in cycles and as a share of the 261,225-cycle block against the budget (docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 rows). The bench cannot set Mode, so TRANSIENT's cost (estimated 2.1k cycles) stays open until the parameter page (S5) or a bench verb exists

steps.say: QA-GLB-196: copy the four BENCH lines (min / avg / max) into docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 COMP rows, and into the module's README; the cap of four instances stays or is lowered from them (spec section 6). Open for the next image, by ear: the level against bypass at the defaults and the click-free bypass (QA-GLB-193), and the Dense8 forced count (`forced` stays 0/0; the aggregate net forced DRIVE dry intermittently on Dense8)
